rows.note: This is the all-purpose casual way to say that someone complies obediently or without resistance.

example.english: When they told me not to make a sound, I docilely sat there.
example.traditional: 佢叫我唔好出聲，我就乖乖咁坐喺度。
example.jyutping: keoi5 giu3 ngo5 m4 hou2 ceot1 seng1 ngo5 zau6 gwaai1 gwaai1 gam3 co5 hai2 dou6
